subject: Pipeline triage & ARR narrative for board packet — action items
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jennifer Alvarez <jennifer@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline triage & ARR narrative for board packet — action items

Team —

We need a short, prioritized triage of all active opportunities that are in the board packet universe. Goal: produce a clean ARR/Bookings narrative and an updated bookings table for the board packet by EOD Monday (Nov 2). Please do the following before EOD Monday: 

1) For every opportunity you own in the Deal Tracker (DEAL-2026-ACME-42 included), update Stage, Expected Close Date, ACV, and Probability.
2) Mark any line that you would NOT include in the committed corridor (i.e., "exclude from commit") and add a single-line reason.
3) Flag any deals that require an executive decision (discount > 30%, legal redlines, SOC2 requirement, procurement hold).
4) Review the ARR bridge tab in the attached board_metrics_template.xlsx and confirm that the math matches your stage-to-commit assumptions.

Quick asks for external partners: Jennifer / Acme procurement — please confirm the procurement timeline you sent last week and whether Nov 15 close is still realistic. Having that on file will decide how we treat ACME in commit.

I'll consolidate inputs and produce the narrative + a short decision log (1‑pagers) for the board packet. If you hit any blockers (legal, SOC 2 evidence, PO timing), flag here so we can escalate.

Thanks —
Karthik
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Attachment: board_metrics_template.xlsx

From: Jennifer Alvarez <jennifer@acme.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pipeline triage & ARR narrative for board packet — action items

Karthik —

Thanks for the heads up. We're still targeting Nov 15 as the earliest possible procurement completion, but our legal is asking for one clarification in the data processing addendum (DPA). I attached a short timeline for internal signoff.

We can commit to a conditional close if Redwood can accept a 30‑day payment term and include the DPA clarification in the SOW. Otherwise procurement will likely push us into December.

I'll be available for a 15 minute sync Friday if that helps.

Best,
Jennifer
Director of Procurement, Acme Corporation

Attachment: acme_procurement_timeline.pdf

Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pipeline triage & ARR narrative for board packet — action items

Karthik / Team —

Quick triage update from Sales ops (I pulled the deal snapshot attached):

- DEAL-2026-ACME-42 (Acme): ACV $420k annual run rate. Stage: Legal Review -> Probability: 70% (conditional on DPA language and 30‑day term). Recommendation: include in "near-commit" corridor with a note: "conditional commit — payment term dependency".
- DEAL-2026-VERD-07 (Veridian Partners): ACV $180k, Stage: Contract Sent -> Probability 90%. Include in commit.
- DEAL-2026-RIV-03 (Riverside): ACV $95k, Stage: Negotiation -> Probability 40%. Exclude from commit; rationale: price sensitivity and pending SOC2 attestation signoff.

Action items for finance (Laura): please confirm whether a conditional commit row is acceptable in the ARR bridge and how you want to show the risk (probability weighted vs. excluded). We need the final numbers by EOD Monday so the board packet picks up consistent assumptions.

Also, Marissa — I'm going to propose we include a one‑line decision log entry for Acme that reads: "Conditional commit pending DPA clarification and 30‑day payment term approval (owner: Karthik)." If no objections by Monday morning, I'll lock that language.

Thanks —
Vivek
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: deal_tracker_snapshot.csv

Cc: Jennifer Alvarez <jennifer@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Pipeline triage & ARR narrative for board packet — action items

All —

I reviewed Vivek's snapshot and Laura's adjustments (Laura, thanks for the quick turnaround). Final decisions we're locking into the board packet:

- Acme (DEAL-2026-ACME-42): Include as "Conditional Commit" at $420k ARR with the decision note Vivek suggested. Finance will also show a probability‑weighted value in the sensitivity appendix.
- Veridian Partners: Commit at $180k.
- Riverside: Exclude from commit.

I've assembled the narrative and uploaded the draft board packet; final version attached. Karthik — I've kept the decision log short and included the point that any payment‑term change will be escalated to you.

If there are no objections by 4:30 PM EST I will mark the packet as final and circulate to the board.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director of GTM Strategy, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: final_board_packet_v2.pdf
